run_gym_environment_demo: run the demo script to interact with the example-cc-v0 CompilerGym environment using gym.make
create_gym_environment: create a CompilerGym environment using gym.make with example-cc-v0 or example-py-v0
reset_environment: reset the gym environment to its initial state using env.reset
step_environment: take a random action step in the gym environment using env.step and env.action_space.sample
import_compiler_gym_service: import the examples.example_compiler_gym_service module to register available gym environments
